features.title: A resident executable self-model

donor_sources.observation: The registry associates callable names with source and cached AST descriptions; it does not establish a native executable self-model.

features.mechanism: Resident program cells bind actual executable entries to source, contracts, generations, and measured behavior.
features.challenge: Refuse a mismatched source/code pair and demonstrate two executable generations within one PID.

features.title: Versioned live function dispatch

donor_sources.observation: Registering transformed Python source replaces a named callable in a dictionary; the donor has no concurrent native generation protocol.

features.mechanism: Atomic generation dispatch with invocation leases and compare-and-swap activation.
features.challenge: Concurrent calls must finish entirely on the generation they acquired, while stale activations fail.

features.title: Typed mutable reasoning IR

donor_sources.observation: The donor parses and transforms Python ASTs and composes callables, but does not verify typed native control flow or effect compatibility.

features.mechanism: Verified typed IR with bounded control flow, native cells, evidence dependencies, and executable lowering.
features.challenge: Reject bad joins, invalid native signatures, and effects on a pure branch before execution.

features.title: Resumable VM generation switching

donor_sources.observation: The donor schedules dependency-ready calls and passes intermediate results; it has no resumable frame migration across program rewrites.

features.mechanism: Stable continuation labels and verified live-value maps permit switching suspended VM frames.
features.challenge: A suspended computation must resume on a new graph without repeating its completed effect.

features.title: Compile candidate C into a live native module

donor_sources.observation: The donor turns generated Python source into callable functions; the proposed extension compiles C into actual native code.

features.mechanism: Compile, inspect, evaluate, and activate a versioned native C entrypoint inside the resident process.
features.challenge: An actual compiled function must change resident execution without restart; malformed candidates never activate.

features.title: Generate and execute bounded machine code in memory

donor_sources.observation: The donor executes transformed Python source; it does not generate machine instructions or manage executable memory.

features.mechanism: Emit a small verified scorer directly into executable memory with platform-correct write/execute transitions.
features.challenge: Execute emitted instructions, then replace their generation in the same PID without a compiler or dlopen.

features.title: Native ABI, relocation, and import contracts

donor_sources.observation: The donor discovers Python functions and invokes them with kwargs; it does not establish machine-level ABI or import compatibility.

features.mechanism: Validate native candidate entrypoints and imports against a bounded host ABI before activation.
features.challenge: Reject incompatible layouts and relocations before any candidate initializer or function executes.

features.title: Safe reclamation of live native generations

donor_sources.observation: The donor stores function references in dictionaries and compositions; it does not handle native image reclamation during concurrent execution.

features.mechanism: Generation leases and quiescence reclaim old code only after all calls and continuations release it.
features.challenge: An old call survives activation and returns correctly; old code unloads only after its last reference drains.

features.title: Transactional migration of resident heap state

donor_sources.observation: The donor retains shared Python locals across executions but supplies no schema-versioned state migration or rollback transaction.

features.mechanism: Prepare and validate a new state graph, then atomically bind it to the matching code generation.
features.challenge: Migration failure leaves old state unchanged; successful migration never pairs new code with old layout.

features.title: Atomic activation of cooperating executable cells

donor_sources.observation: The donor composes named functions but updates registrations individually, without a transaction over interdependent executable versions.

features.mechanism: Bundle validation and atomic generation roots keep cooperating native cells on one compatible version set.
features.challenge: Concurrent callers observe either the complete old bundle or the complete new bundle, never mixed results.

features.title: Shadow native candidates with replayed observations

donor_sources.observation: The donor forwards dependency results and caches call outputs; it has no native shadow-execution contract preventing duplicate effects.

features.mechanism: Shadow native generations consume exact recorded observations while real effects execute once through the active path.
features.challenge: A shadow attempt to alter or repeat a recorded effect must stop; valid replay produces comparable native outputs.

features.title: Counterexample-guided native executable synthesis

donor_sources.observation: The donor can define and transform executable Python tools; it does not require an independent oracle or preserve counterexamples across revisions.

features.mechanism: Generate native candidates, execute independent oracles, minimize counterexamples, and admit only surviving implementations.
features.challenge: A candidate that memorizes visible examples must fail hidden cases; repaired code must execute in the resident process.

features.title: Resident rollback with a bounded behavioral watchdog

donor_sources.observation: The donor contains failed replicas and chooses a survivor; it does not roll back resident executable generations.

features.mechanism: Watchdog-monitored native generation activation with safe rollback of future dispatch and compatible state.
features.challenge: A behavioral regression triggers same-PID rollback while in-flight calls retain valid generation ownership.

features.title: Causal profiling mapped to executable versions

donor_sources.observation: The donor records per-operation calls, timing, and errors, but has no attribution to live native code generations or causal improvement experiments.

features.mechanism: Attribute native execution costs and verified outcomes to exact code versions and decision contexts.
features.challenge: Calls spanning a hot swap must remain attributed to their acquired generation, and pure delay must not look like quality gain.

features.title: Effect-aware executable composition

donor_sources.observation: The donor composes callables by forwarding values directly, without typed effect analysis or per-stage governance.

features.mechanism: Compose native cells and governed observations into typed programs whose optimizer respects effects and evidence.
features.challenge: Reject illegal reordering or duplicated effects while parallelizing truly independent pure stages.

features.title: Profile-driven native specialization

donor_sources.observation: The donor rewrites Python ASTs and chains functions but does not specialize native executable paths from measured runtime invariants.

features.mechanism: Partial evaluation creates guarded native specializations with correct deoptimization to the generic implementation.
features.challenge: An input violating specialization guards must execute the generic path and preserve exact semantics.

features.title: Verified ephemeral tools synthesized as native code

donor_sources.observation: The donor defines executable tools from source and lists them, but lacks independently verified native admission and DSCO capability enforcement.

features.mechanism: Synthesize a bounded native tool, qualify its contract, and expose it for governed use during the resident session.
features.challenge: A new native tool must solve unseen cases, and denied effects must remain denied through its dynamic dispatch.

features.title: Learn semantics-tested executable rewrite operators

donor_sources.observation: The donor has hand-authored AST rename and decorator operations; it does not learn reusable transformations from verified improvement pairs.

features.mechanism: Generalize successful code changes into guarded rewrite operators and promote them only after held-out equivalence checks.
features.challenge: A rewrite that improves training examples but changes hidden semantics must not enter the learned operator library.

features.title: An evolution curriculum that retains prior capabilities

donor_sources.observation: The donor invokes optimizers with a default substring-or-nonempty-answer metric; it does not protect previously acquired native capabilities during evolution.

features.mechanism: Evolve native implementations against staged tasks, held-out oracles, and retained capability constraints.
features.challenge: A candidate gaining a new task while regressing a required old capability must be rejected.

features.title: A closed-loop same-process native self-repair demonstration

donor_sources.observation: The donor asks an LM structured questions about progress and improvement; it does not rewrite and activate resident machine code.

features.mechanism: Observe a real defect, synthesize and qualify a native repair, activate it in the same PID, then roll back a later regression.
features.challenge: The full loop must change executed native bytes without exec and reject or roll back a deceptive later candidate.

features.title: Bind self-modification claims to executable evidence

donor_sources.observation: Extracted notes are free-form strings; sources are recorded at retrieval level, and each context is truncated to its first 500 characters.

features.mechanism: Typed claims bind immutable source spans and behavioral receipts to resident procedure identities.
features.challenge: A passing test from the old procedure must not validate its replacement, and a fabricated quotation must not resolve.

features.title: Investigate the missing obligations of a self-rewrite

donor_sources.observation: The next query uses accumulated notes and a hop number; there is no explicit representation of unanswered obligations or coverage.

features.mechanism: An explicit obligation frontier chooses investigations that can establish replacement correctness.
features.challenge: An optimization supported only by average latency must remain incomplete while cancellation and ownership obligations are unresolved.

features.title: Resolve conflicting explanations through directed retrieval

donor_sources.observation: All notes accumulate together; contradictory statements do not trigger a targeted distinguishing query or separate hypotheses.

features.mechanism: Conflict records generate discriminating retrieval queries before a self-rewrite rationale is accepted.
features.challenge: A stale design document and current execution trace disagree about a lock; the reasoner must inspect the actual revision and call path.

features.title: Prevent copied evidence from becoming false consensus

donor_sources.observation: Results from different retrievers are merged by raw score; no originating-source or copied-content independence is modeled.

features.mechanism: Evidence families separate relevance and repetition from independent corroboration of rewrite hypotheses.
features.challenge: Twenty copied performance summaries must not outweigh one independent failing execution.

features.title: Stop self-investigation when retrieval adds no knowledge

donor_sources.observation: The loop always attempts num_hops, continues after errors, and reports configured hop_count rather than successful information-gathering steps.

features.mechanism: A bounded retrieval controller measures novel evidence and obligation progress instead of fixed hop count.
features.challenge: Repeated mirrors and paraphrased queries must stop without falsely increasing confidence or exhausting the entire turn.

features.title: Retrieve typed evidence from the resident runtime and source corpus

donor_sources.observation: A generic source string and raw score combine heterogeneous results without typed joins, calibrated ranking, or execution identity.

features.mechanism: Structured predicates and actual lexical or semantic retrieval produce typed evidence for self-investigation.
features.challenge: A similarly named function in another revision must not outrank the exact failing invocation merely because its prose matches.

features.title: Extract evidence that survives different chunk boundaries

donor_sources.observation: Aggregation deduplicates normalized strings, records chunk starts rather than exact spans, and counts entity and bias occurrences repeatedly across overlaps.

features.mechanism: Canonical source spans make learned claims independent of chunking and overlapping observation windows.
features.challenge: The same assertion straddling two windows must count once, while two real occurrences remain distinguishable.

features.title: Distinguish real contradictions from revision and time changes

donor_sources.observation: Claims retain text and chunk location but no temporal validity, revision scope, typed predicate, or cross-document contradiction relation.

features.mechanism: Typed claim scopes expose unresolved contradictions without erasing historical truths.
features.challenge: A function safe in revision A and unsafe in revision B is a change, while simultaneous incompatible claims about B are a conflict.

features.title: Preserve modality and attribution in learned memory

donor_sources.observation: The extractor distinguishes claims, beliefs and utterances, but document aggregation discards utterances and does not preserve modality or attribution relationships.

features.mechanism: Typed modality and quotation edges prevent hypothetical or attributed text from becoming operative procedure assumptions.
features.challenge: A paper quoting an unsafe recommendation to refute it must not teach the runtime to adopt that recommendation.

features.title: Invalidate learned conclusions when their content dependencies change

donor_sources.observation: Analysis keys use PDF path, chunk size, overlap and model, omitting source content, extractor version, prompt signature and derived-claim dependencies.

features.mechanism: Content-addressed derivation edges allow precise invalidation of learned procedure assumptions.
features.challenge: Replacing source bytes at the same path must invalidate dependent optimization conclusions without discarding independent evidence.

features.title: Verify decisive algorithm evidence against PDF pages and figures

donor_sources.observation: The implementation transcribes rasterized pages, applies max_pages only after rendering the whole PDF, and treats response length as its main validity check.

features.mechanism: Selective page verification links algorithm-adoption claims to exact visual and extracted evidence.
features.challenge: A missing minus sign or log-scale axis must reverse an apparently favorable algorithm comparison before adoption.

features.title: Make self-improvement performance claims executable

donor_sources.observation: Quality is an average of positive model-generated scores; failed chunks are omitted, and no executable dimensional or denominator checks substantiate aggregate claims.

features.mechanism: Structured quantities and executable estimators determine whether a resident replacement improves its stated metric.
features.challenge: A faster mean on fewer successful requests must not be accepted as a latency improvement for the full workload.

features.title: Localize its own failures through competing source hypotheses

donor_sources.observation: Perception uses keywords, planning uses input length, and reflection records response_received=True without relating failure observations to source hypotheses.

features.mechanism: A typed fault graph maps observed failures to source predicates and discriminating experiments.
features.challenge: The last logged function must not be blamed automatically when an earlier ownership transfer caused the failure.

features.title: Record predicted observations before running self-experiments

donor_sources.observation: Hooks carry request IDs and ordered stop decisions, but do not encode hypotheses, preregistered predictions or comparison of expected versus actual observations.

features.mechanism: An immutable prediction ledger prevents retrospective rewriting of what an experiment was supposed to establish.
features.challenge: After a failed experiment the agent cannot rewrite its original prediction and report confirmation.

features.title: Branch and merge competing research states without erasing dissent

donor_sources.observation: A single notes list accumulates all reasoning and final synthesis; alternative research states and contradictory supports are not separately preserved.

features.mechanism: Immutable research scopes support bounded competing explanations and explicit evidence-preserving merges.
features.challenge: Two branches choosing different replacement algorithms must merge their counterexamples rather than selecting whichever report arrived last.

features.title: Execute cognitive stages with typed results and bounded repair

donor_sources.observation: Actions are ordered, but handlers consume the original message; reflection unconditionally marks a response received, and the verifier exercises a mock rather than real-client reasoning.

features.mechanism: Explicit stage outputs make perception, planning, execution, reflection and repair operational.
features.challenge: A deliberately wrong execution result must cause a bounded repair or rejection, never unconditional success.

features.title: Preempt long self-investigation without losing cognitive state

donor_sources.observation: A single executor awaits each action; stop cancels it, results are not checkpointed, and failed prerequisites can leave descendants pending indefinitely.

features.mechanism: Checkpointed reasoning continuations separate responsive input from resumable long cognitive work.
features.challenge: A stalled retrieval during self-rewrite analysis must not lose an urgent user correction or rerun an already completed experiment on resume.

features.title: Require evidence-sensitive completion or explicit abstention

donor_sources.observation: Confidence is parsed from model-generated text, defaults to 50 on parsing failure, and synthesis proceeds even when no retrieval succeeded.

features.mechanism: Completion predicates distinguish supported resident improvement from incomplete research and unsupported confidence.
features.challenge: A model claiming 99 percent confidence after all retrievals fail must not mark a replacement ready.

features.title: Replay reasoning under controlled framing interventions

donor_sources.observation: Bias detection emits labels from the first 2,000 characters; there is no controlled intervention establishing whether framing actually changes a decision.

features.mechanism: Paired controlled interventions measure whether irrelevant evidence presentation changes a self-rewrite decision.
features.challenge: Changing a source prestige label or evidence order must not silently change adoption when facts and validity are fixed.

features.title: Reopen learned procedures when their evidence expires

donor_sources.observation: PDF text reuse is content-addressed, but downstream analysis and learned conclusions have no validity lease tied to runtime changes or expiring observations.

features.mechanism: Evidence validity monitors reopen only the learned procedures whose assumptions no longer hold.
features.challenge: A cached improvement validated under an old runtime configuration must stop claiming current support after that configuration changes.

features.title: Compile reasoning methods into executable obligations

donor_sources.observation: One ChainOfThought receives all lenses; automatic selection uses substring rules.

features.mechanism: Typed method DAG with applicability predicates, required inputs, checked operations, and obligations.
features.challenge: Missing competing likelihood prevents Bayesian execution; a quoted keyword does not select a method.

features.title: Compete causal fault hypotheses before rewriting

donor_sources.observation: Abduction is an LM signature; scientific deduction and causal execution remain commented steps.

features.mechanism: Competing fault hypotheses predict probe outcomes and are eliminated by observed counterexamples.
features.challenge: A probe equally predicted by both hypotheses earns no discriminating credit.

features.title: Check deductive fragments for candidate preconditions

donor_sources.observation: A model emits validity and inference prose; there is no formal proof checker.

features.mechanism: Small proof kernel checks bounded predicates and inference rules tied to candidate preconditions.
features.challenge: Affirming the consequent, integer overflow, and unsupported generalization fail independently of persuasive text.

features.title: Perform fully specified Bayesian candidate revision

donor_sources.observation: The signature lacks an alternative likelihood; scientific workflow supplies fixed prior .5 and placeholder likelihood .8.

features.mechanism: Deterministic posterior calculation with competing likelihoods, dependence groups, and sensitivity intervals.
features.challenge: One-percent prior with .99 sensitivity and .05 false-positive rate yields about16.67%, not99%.

features.title: Identify causal benefit of runtime interventions

donor_sources.observation: causal_graph is a natural-language methodology instruction; no intervention evaluator exists.

features.mechanism: Typed causal graph and controlled change comparison separate intervention effects from confounding.
features.challenge: A warm cache improves both old and new code; sequential benchmark timing must not credit the patch.

features.title: Forecast candidate performance from comparable episodes

donor_sources.observation: Reference-class statistics are supplied by a model rather than retrieved empirical cohorts.

features.mechanism: Eligibility-defined comparable cohorts produce performance distributions and transport warnings.
features.challenge: Removing failed candidates or mixing hardware generations changes apparent benefit and must be exposed.

features.title: Choose code changes on robust constrained frontiers

donor_sources.observation: decision_theory requests prose expected-value comparisons without constraint-solving implementation.

features.mechanism: Hard feasibility gates precede Pareto and robust-regret comparisons across uncertain candidate outcomes.
features.challenge: A faster candidate with one correctness violation cannot buy admission with any speed score.

features.title: Select the next experiment by decision value

donor_sources.observation: cruxes and next_steps are generated text with no expected decision-value calculation.

features.mechanism: Enumerate experiment outcomes and calculate expected decision improvement minus resource cost.
features.challenge: A high-entropy unknown that cannot change the selected implementation has zero decision value.

features.title: Turn rewrite premortems into executable conditions

donor_sources.observation: Premortem outputs failure scenarios and mitigations as model-generated text.

features.mechanism: Candidate-specific failure models compile to bounded predicates and corresponding decision transitions.
features.challenge: Missing telemetry is unknown and counter reset cannot satisfy a safety trigger.

features.title: Transfer algorithms through structural analogy checks

donor_sources.observation: Analogy mapping, disanalogies and confidence are emitted by a model without an applicability checker.

features.mechanism: Typed relational mappings transfer algorithmic templates only when required semantic boundaries hold.
features.challenge: A cache strategy valid for idempotent reads must not transfer to exactly-once mutations.

features.title: Ground decision-bias audits in source spans

donor_sources.observation: The signature requests evidence spans but permissive assembly accepts incomplete or malformed bias records.

features.mechanism: Audit decision dependencies using exact spans and executable relevance checks without forcing bias labels.
features.challenge: Mentioning past investment as historical context alone must not count as sunk-cost reasoning.

features.title: Test code decisions for framing invariance

donor_sources.observation: Counterpositions and deliberate reconsideration are generated prose without controlled invariance tests.

features.mechanism: Meaning-preserving decision transformations reveal unjustified recommendation shifts across wording and anchors.
features.challenge: Equivalent ninety-percent success versus ten-percent failure records should not reverse identical code choices.

features.title: Propagate critique into code decisions

donor_sources.observation: Corrected analyses are produced but final_synthesis still returns the original multi.synthesis.

features.mechanism: Material critiques invalidate dependent decisions until accepted, rebutted, or explicitly unresolved.
features.challenge: A disproven bounds premise cannot survive into the final choice through an unchanged original synthesis.

features.title: Investigate rewrite candidates with independent dissent

donor_sources.observation: One pipeline generates counterarguments then asks a model to synthesize a balanced view.

features.mechanism: Blind independent investigations adjudicate disagreement with reproducible witnesses rather than majority votes.
features.challenge: Three agreeing investigators citing one erroneous measurement cannot outvote a concrete failing input.

features.title: Calibrate rewrite confidence against actual outcomes

donor_sources.observation: Evaluation uses model score strings; absent post-analysis can yield verification_success=True.
A failed verification bias detector sets biases_after to zero while the reduction operation still reports success.

features.mechanism: Proper scoring and calibrated decision bins distinguish predicted success, observed success, failure, and unknown.
features.challenge: Verification timeout must remain unknown and never improve a candidate success statistic.

features.title: Bound rewrite resources with dimensional estimates

donor_sources.observation: fermi_estimation is a textual instruction, with no units or interval arithmetic implementation.

features.mechanism: Dimensioned interval expressions estimate candidate resource demand and expose dominant uncertainties.
features.challenge: Requests per second times bytes per request is bandwidth, not total memory without a retention duration.

features.title: Escalate reasoning only when observed risk warrants it

donor_sources.observation: Dual process always runs two model stages; weak recognition can still become the final heuristic decision.

features.mechanism: Risk features and unresolved obligations trigger deeper reasoning while exact easy cases stay deterministic.
features.challenge: Confident cheap-model output cannot suppress escalation for a patch changing ownership or bounds.

features.title: Allocate reasoning portfolios by complementary error

donor_sources.observation: Independent stages run in two fixed waves; activation is based on simple query substrings.

features.mechanism: Select bounded method/model sets by measured marginal error coverage and resource cost.
features.challenge: Two highly accurate agents making the same errors can add less value than a weaker complementary verifier.

features.title: Distill runtime lessons into typed executable procedures

donor_sources.observation: Reusable methods are textual procedure descriptions and generated findings, not checked executable recipes.

features.mechanism: Successful episodes yield parameterized procedures with preconditions, governed operations, and transfer tests.
features.challenge: A lesson that hardcodes one example path or repeats a failed action cannot pass transfer acceptance.

features.title: Optimize prompts programs and topology under one oracle

donor_sources.observation: MIPROv2/GEPA wrappers exist; default metric rewards nonempty output or expected-answer substring.

features.mechanism: Bounded joint search mutates prompt instructions, typed procedure choices, and reasoning topology against independent validation.
features.challenge: Expected-answer text embedded in a wrong output and altered grader code must never earn promotion.

features.title: Train an RLM to reproduce decisive native schedules

donor_sources.observation: The donor dispatches dependency-ready waves but does not record thread interleavings or train a replay specialist.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns trace decomposition and schedule selection against deterministic replay of cooperative native cells.
features.challenge: Reproduce a failing interleaving after wall-clock delays change and reject a fabricated replay schedule.

features.title: Train an RLM to prove bounded executable equivalence

donor_sources.observation: The donor transforms ASTs without proving output equivalence or training a proof-decomposition policy.

features.mechanism: An RLM decomposes bounded bitvector equivalence obligations and learns from independent solver certificates or counterexamples.
features.challenge: An overflow-sensitive rewrite must yield a concrete differing input instead of an unsupported equivalence claim.

features.title: Train an RLM for reversible debugging of pure native cells

donor_sources.observation: The donor collects operation telemetry but provides no instruction-state rewind or trained reversible-debugging policy.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns where to checkpoint and rewind deterministic pure cells to isolate the first semantic divergence.
features.challenge: Rewind across a branch and reproduce values exactly; attempting to rewind an external effect must be refused.

features.title: Train an RLM to minimize native counterexamples structurally

donor_sources.observation: The donor extracts code structure but does not minimize behavioral witnesses while preserving a failure predicate.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns grammar-preserving reductions guided by an independent native failure-identity oracle.
features.challenge: A smaller crashing input with a different defect must not replace the original counterexample.

features.title: Train an RLM for executable change-impact slicing

donor_sources.observation: The donor analyzes workflow dependencies, not native data/control dependencies or learned change-impact slicing.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns semantic impact slices that drive targeted recompilation and qualification without missing affected contracts.
features.challenge: A changed branch predicate must invalidate a downstream result even when its direct call graph is unchanged.

features.title: Train an RLM to construct checkable loop resource certificates

donor_sources.observation: The donor checks basic workflow structure but does not prove termination or train certificate synthesis.

features.mechanism: An RLM proposes ranking functions and resource bounds that a small independent verifier checks for admitted loops.
features.challenge: Reject a decreasing-looking loop whose counter wraps and exceeds its claimed bound.

features.title: Train an RLM to synthesize pointer-free native host bindings

donor_sources.observation: The donor derives operation metadata from Python signatures but does not generate checked native host-handle bindings.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns typed handle interfaces and ownership adapters, qualified by adversarial lifetime and capability checks.
features.challenge: A stale or cross-kind handle must never resolve after slot reuse or code replacement.

features.title: Train an RLM to generate SIMD native batch kernels

donor_sources.observation: The donor transforms executable Python functions but does not generate vector instructions or establish scalar parity.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns vectorization and tail-handling choices for native batch cells using scalar-oracle rewards.
features.challenge: Tail lengths, misalignment, and unsupported ISA must preserve scalar semantics without out-of-bounds reads.

features.title: Train an RLM to autotune resident data layouts

donor_sources.observation: The donor uses Python column dictionaries for simplified analytics, not a native layout optimizer or a real DuckDB engine.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns array-of-structures, structure-of-arrays, and blocked layouts under exact semantics and migration constraints.
features.challenge: A faster layout must not lose concurrent writes or break external schema access.

features.title: Train an RLM to remove allocations through escape analysis

donor_sources.observation: The donor identifies structural syntax but does not prove lifetimes or optimize allocation placement.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns escape-analysis proposals whose independently checked ownership facts permit arena or stack rewrites.
features.challenge: A callback-retained reference must prevent temporary allocation placement even if ordinary tests return early.

features.title: Train an RLM to adapt native algorithms to allocation pressure

donor_sources.observation: The donor records operation timings and failures but does not learn native algorithm choices from memory-pressure feedback.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns guarded selection between memory-intensive and streaming native variants using measured pressure and verified outcomes.
features.challenge: Memory pressure must change the chosen algorithm without oscillation, lost results, or falsely claiming an allocation estimate is measured.

features.title: Train an RLM to reconstruct deoptimization state

donor_sources.observation: The donor forwards prior results between calls, but cannot reconstruct a suspended native frame into an interpreter continuation.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns precise native-to-IR state maps checked through forced deoptimization and suffix equivalence.
features.challenge: Every supported safepoint must reconstruct logical values and resume without duplicating completed effects.

features.title: Train an RLM for semantic incremental native compilation

donor_sources.observation: The donor caches AST descriptions and transforms whole registered tools, not semantic native dependency units.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns compilation-unit boundaries and reuse decisions checked against clean rebuilds of changed programs.
features.challenge: A semantic change hidden behind an unchanged symbol name must rebuild its dependent specialized code.

features.title: Train an RLM for generation-aware native source debugging

donor_sources.observation: The donor stores source and line-oriented structure but has no live native breakpoint mapping or trained debugging policy.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns generation-specific breakpoint and inspection actions using independently checked native failure localization.
features.challenge: A breakpoint must inspect the source and locals of its pinned generation despite a concurrent replacement.

features.title: Train an RLM for cross-compiler native qualification

donor_sources.observation: The donor selects answer replicas by judge or heuristics, not native executable behavior across independent compilers.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns compiler/configuration experiments that expose undefined behavior and qualify portable native rewrites.
features.challenge: Compiler agreement cannot accept a candidate that independently violates the oracle, and disagreement must remain unresolved.

features.title: Train an RLM to search native optimization phase orders

donor_sources.observation: The donor applies transformations in supplied list order without learning interactions or checking optimization outcomes.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns sequences of known native rewrite passes while equivalence and whole-program cost constrain search.
features.challenge: A phase order that wins microbenchmarks but regresses the complete executable must not be promoted.

features.title: Train an RLM for checked speculative native parallelization

donor_sources.observation: The donor runs declared parallel or dependency-ready calls but does not speculate over unknown native data dependencies.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns speculative partitions with transactional read/write validation and exact serial fallback.
features.challenge: A hidden dependency conflict must discard speculative state and reproduce the serial result without duplicated effects.

features.title: Train an RLM to optimize native precision under error contracts

donor_sources.observation: The donor supplies mathematical operations but does not learn native precision or reduction order under independently checked numerical-error limits.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns precision, summation, and vector reduction choices subject to explicit numerical error and stability contracts.
features.challenge: A fast reduction that fails catastrophic-cancellation or NaN behavior must be rejected despite ordinary-data gains.

features.title: Train an RLM for budgeted native compilation reuse

donor_sources.observation: The donor caches operation results by arguments and TTL, not executable artifacts with semantic identities and pinned generations.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns compilation-cache admission and eviction from reuse trajectories while code lifetime remains mechanically enforced.
features.challenge: An evicted artifact must never unmap active code; changed ABI or compiler semantics must prevent stale reuse.

features.title: Train an RLM for lossless logical code-cell checkpoints

donor_sources.observation: The donor retains Python locals in memory but does not serialize typed executable continuations or validate their restoration.

features.mechanism: An RLM learns logical-state checkpoint schemas and reconstruction programs checked by resumed execution equivalence.
features.challenge: Restore into different addresses without raw pointers, repeated effects, or changed suffix outputs.

features.title: Train a trace-to-state-machine induction RLM

donor_sources.observation: Induction requests a textual generalization and possible counterexamples; it does not infer executable state machines from traces.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs that partition traces, infer executable transition systems, and validate them on unseen sequences.
features.challenge: Identical output prefixes followed by different legal continuations must not be merged into one state.

features.title: Train an active protocol-learning RLM

donor_sources.observation: The donor generates retrieval queries over notes; it has no membership-query or equivalence-counterexample protocol-learning loop.

features.mechanism: Learn economical root query programs that identify an opaque resettable tool protocol.
features.challenge: A retry that consumes a token changes protocol state even though its visible response matches a harmless retry.

features.title: Train an executable API-contract mining RLM

donor_sources.observation: AST inspection extracts declarations and arguments; registration validates syntax but does not infer behavioral preconditions or postconditions.

features.mechanism: Learn root decompositions that turn implementations and examples into executable, falsifiable API contracts.
features.challenge: A nonempty output is not success when the API contract requires a matching request identity and sorted records.

features.title: Train minimal causal-feature discovery for failures

donor_sources.observation: Causality is requested as generated text; the workflow leaves causal analysis unimplemented rather than discovering causal features through interventions.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs that isolate small intervention-supported feature sets explaining procedure failures.
features.challenge: A timestamp correlated with crashes must lose to the actual ownership-state feature when interventions separate them.

features.title: Train quality-diversity search over rewrite behaviors

donor_sources.observation: The donor selects individual define, compose, inspect or transform actions; it maintains no behavior-space archive or learned diversity-seeking search policy.

features.mechanism: Learn root search programs that maintain independently qualified behavioral niches instead of one brittle champion.
features.challenge: An extremely fast candidate on uniform inputs must not erase a robust candidate needed for skewed workloads.

features.title: Train constrained Bayesian compiler-search programs

donor_sources.observation: Strategy selection multiplies fixed confidence values by hand-written mode weights; it does not learn acquisition decisions from compiler measurements.

features.mechanism: Learn root orchestration of fitted surrogate models and constrained acquisitions over compiler settings.
features.challenge: An aggressive flag combination with excellent speed but incorrect overflow behavior must remain infeasible.

features.title: Train propensity-aware contextual exploration

donor_sources.observation: Strategies use hand-assigned confidences and fixed weights; there are no logged action propensities or counterfactual policy estimates.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs for constrained contextual exploration with valid propensity logs and off-policy evaluation.
features.challenge: A policy favored only because easy tasks received its actions must fail a properly weighted comparison.

features.title: Train pairwise ranking of rewrite candidates

donor_sources.observation: The selector sorts fixed confidence-weight products rather than learning rankings from controlled pairwise outcomes.

features.mechanism: Learn root comparison programs and candidate rankings from independent paired outcomes with ties and incompatibility.
features.challenge: A verbose candidate rationale cannot beat a concise candidate with stronger matched-workload evidence.

features.title: Train compositional task generation from capability grammars

donor_sources.observation: Composition chains named callables but does not generate typed challenge distributions or verify task solvability from capability grammars.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs that generate solvable, oracle-backed compositions testing new runtime capabilities.
features.challenge: A generated challenge must not require an unavailable capability or hide an impossible postcondition behind fluent wording.

features.title: Train adversarial coevolution with a protected referee

donor_sources.observation: Bias critique is generated text and final synthesis remains the original multi-strategy synthesis; no adversary learns tests against an independent executable referee.

features.mechanism: Train a root adversary to generate valid counterexamples while preserving a separate immutable referee.
features.challenge: A test that merely changes the specification or crashes the harness must not earn credit for defeating a candidate.

features.title: Train executable invariant discovery with held-out checking

donor_sources.observation: The signatures request laws and validity labels from an LM; they do not discover executable predicates and verify them against unseen transitions.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs that propose bounded invariants and refine them with executable counterexamples.
features.challenge: An invariant learned from positive counters must fail when a hidden wraparound transition violates it.

features.title: Train error-cluster curriculum scheduling

donor_sources.observation: Adjustment checks a tool success-rate threshold and emits generic alternatives; it does not learn curriculum choices from structured error clusters.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs that choose training episodes from error structure and measured learning progress.
features.challenge: A huge duplicate cluster of easy failures must not consume all training while a small catastrophic class is forgotten.

features.title: Train abstract-interpretation-guided candidate bounding

donor_sources.observation: The AST analyzer extracts declarations and syntax structure; it does not compute abstract states or bound candidate execution.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs that select sound abstract domains and refinement steps around a trusted analysis engine.
features.challenge: A rare loop-growth path must not be certified bounded because sampled traces terminate.

features.title: Train semantic indexing by executable behavior

donor_sources.observation: Registry discovery exposes names, descriptions and AST metadata; it does not index procedures by independently observed input/output behavior.

features.mechanism: Learn root probing and retrieval programs that identify procedures by behavioral signatures and counterexamples.
features.challenge: Two similarly named functions differing only on empty input must remain distinguishable in retrieval.

features.title: Train uncertainty-aware surrogate performance reasoning

donor_sources.observation: The workflow passes fixed prior 0.5 and placeholder likelihood 0.8; it does not fit performance-response models or evaluate their uncertainty on observations.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs that fit and challenge real conditional performance surrogates for novel candidates.
features.challenge: A surrogate trained on small arrays must flag unsupported extrapolation to cache-thrashing sizes.

features.title: Train amortized experiment-selection policies

donor_sources.observation: Immediate actions take the first few selected tools and next steps are generic strings; no policy is learned from experiment outcomes.

features.mechanism: Learn root experiment-selection programs across tasks instead of recomputing only a supplied analytic value table.
features.challenge: A memorized cheap probe must be rejected when its result cannot distinguish the current hypotheses.

features.title: Train hierarchical skill-option induction

donor_sources.observation: Actions have dependencies and completion status, but there is no learned initiation set, reusable subpolicy or termination condition for a temporal option.

features.mechanism: Learn root segmentation and synthesis of reusable options with checked initiation and termination behavior.
features.challenge: A retry-until-success fragment must not become an unbounded skill that runs after its preconditions stop holding.

features.title: Train online concept-drift segmentation

donor_sources.observation: Strategy adjustment uses aggregate tool success-rate thresholds; it does not infer changing regimes or distinguish drift from isolated failures.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs that detect latent operating-regime changes and select scoped relearning actions.
features.challenge: A single outlier must not trigger a new regime, while a persistent shifted workload must not be averaged away.

features.title: Train compression-driven reusable procedure libraries

donor_sources.observation: Composition joins named callables and transformations are hand-authored; the donor does not extract a reusable library by jointly compressing many programs.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs that discover shared abstractions minimizing checked description length across a corpus.
features.challenge: A short library that memorizes training constants or changes effect order must lose despite excellent apparent compression.

features.title: Train transfer attribution and negative-transfer prevention

donor_sources.observation: Analogy requests similarities and inferred features from an LM; it does not measure whether transferred learning improves independent target tasks.

features.mechanism: Learn root programs that design transfer ablations and reject source knowledge causing target regressions.
features.challenge: A transferred caching skill that helps pure transforms but corrupts stateful counters must be rejected for the latter target.

features.title: Give every role an independently trained RLM identity

donor_sources.observation: ModelSpec binds static model settings to roles but has no trained-weight or adapter lineage.

features.mechanism: Role registry binds immutable root checkpoint, tokenizer, adapter, environment, curriculum and frozen-leaf identities.
features.challenge: A renamed base checkpoint or adapter for another role must not be accepted as a newly trained role model.

features.title: Implement the external-context RLM execution contract

donor_sources.observation: The cognitive program passes rendered conversation text into one model call; it does not implement external prompt state.

features.mechanism: Persistent context variables and programmatic recursion expose bounded observations and return Final by reference.
features.challenge: Huge stdout or a large final variable must not be copied into root history or truncated into the returned answer.

features.title: Train programmatic recursion within role boundaries

donor_sources.observation: The hierarchical swarm routes listed subtasks to workers; it is not a learned recursive REPL call policy.

features.mechanism: Role root adapters learn loop-generated recursive calls with immutable lineage and host-enforced role effects.
features.challenge: Programmatically generated child calls cannot request a broader role or escape the inherited capability set.

features.title: Export faithful root-turn training trajectories

donor_sources.observation: The donor records inference usage receipts but does not export token-faithful root-turn training examples.

features.mechanism: Exporter reconstructs each root prefix and one generated target while preserving observations and excluding child targets.
features.challenge: Flattening child assistant turns into root targets or including future observations must fail validation.

features.title: Distill only executable teacher trajectories

donor_sources.observation: The default optimizer metric rewards answer substrings rather than verified execution outcomes.

features.mechanism: Teacher RLM rollouts are replayed and filtered by an independent task oracle before root-adapter SFT.
features.challenge: A correct answer string with nonexecuting code or unverifiable tool results must not enter the accepted training set.

features.title: Align root SFT targets with actual token boundaries

donor_sources.observation: Program persistence saves DSPy program artifacts, not tokenizer-aligned root-model loss masks.

features.mechanism: Renderer-owned serialization assigns loss only to the selected root generation and validates tensor-level gradients.
features.challenge: Literal assistant markers inside tool output cannot acquire supervision or shift target masks.

features.title: Expose each role as a verifiable RLM environment

donor_sources.observation: The donor evaluates DSPy predictions with a callable metric rather than an isolated executable role environment.

features.mechanism: Version-pinned environment and harness adapters map role tasks to RLM episodes and immutable terminal oracles.
features.challenge: Generated code cannot edit grading files, and a zero-reward or failed episode cannot disappear from statistics.

features.title: Bridge role root datasets to actual Prime SFT jobs

donor_sources.observation: The wrappers optimize DSPy programs and do not launch neural root-model SFT.

features.mechanism: C-owned training manifests drive pinned prime-rl SFT with role-specific root targets and artifact validation.
features.challenge: Configuration-only success, unchanged tensors, or a trainer silently using messages instead of root targets must fail acceptance.

features.title: Train role roots with terminal verifiable rewards

donor_sources.observation: The evaluator uses heuristic coherence and model-produced scores rather than executable terminal rewards.

features.mechanism: Root-policy RL updates use immutable terminal rewards and root-only action attribution with frozen leaves.
features.challenge: Reward hacking, empty rollouts and timeouts cannot be scored as correct or yield fabricated optimizer progress.

features.title: Separate root and leaf learning credit experimentally

donor_sources.observation: The pipeline uses distinct root and leaf workers but has no factorial weight-training attribution experiment.

features.mechanism: Paired factorial evaluations isolate root-update, leaf-update and interaction effects on RLM outcomes.
features.challenge: A stronger leaf silently substituted after root training must not be credited to the root adapter.

features.title: Learn recursion depth and batching as root behavior

donor_sources.observation: Fanout and concurrency are configured ceilings rather than a trained context-dependent recursive policy.

features.mechanism: Root adapter learns when to recurse, how deeply and how to batch while the host enforces hard ceilings.
features.challenge: Blind maximum recursion or batching across dependent items loses correctness despite fewer model invocations.

features.title: Measure role RLM length generalization

donor_sources.observation: History is limited by turn count and per-turn character truncation, not evaluated for algorithmic length generalization.

features.mechanism: Train-short evaluate-long suites vary context length and semantic work independently with exact oracles.
features.challenge: Needles fixed at the same offsets or train/eval duplicates must not masquerade as length generalization.

features.title: Serve isolated role adapters by immutable version

donor_sources.observation: Static model normalization does not pin per-role trained adapters or prevent serving cross-contamination.

features.mechanism: Serving snapshots bind one role adapter to each recursive tree with explicit compatibility and update receipts.
features.challenge: Concurrent adapter reload cannot switch an in-flight tree or serve role A with role B weights.

features.title: Train interrole protocols against frozen partners

donor_sources.observation: Typed subtask and child-result schemas exist, but no role-specific neural protocol co-training loop.

features.mechanism: Alternating role-root updates learn useful typed messages against version-pinned partners and cross-play evaluation.
features.challenge: Partners colluding through leaked labels or changing together cannot establish one role learned a transferable protocol.

features.title: Split role training data by repository ancestry

donor_sources.observation: Trainset and devset are caller-supplied without repository ancestry or near-duplicate split enforcement.

features.mechanism: Split planner prevents source, episode, patch-family and generated-task leakage before role weight training.
features.challenge: Renamed copies, nearby commits and paraphrased tasks cannot cross into holdout without being detected.

features.title: Train recovery from REPL syntax and finalization errors

donor_sources.observation: The stream yields a final result only if a final prediction arrives, without a learned executable correction dataset.

features.mechanism: State-matched error/correction trajectories train role roots to repair code and finalize without fabricated observations.
features.challenge: Repaired syntax that silently drops required work or returns an undefined final variable remains incorrect.

features.title: Train asynchronous recursion policies without blocking input

donor_sources.observation: Two fixed asyncio.gather waves execute concurrently without a learned scheduler or explicit partial-outcome contract.

features.mechanism: Root adapters learn submit-await-cancel batching under host-enforced budgets and responsive asynchronous admission.
features.challenge: A policy cannot gain reward by dropping slow tasks, hiding errors or blocking terminal input during training.

features.title: Distill across roles without hiding negative transfer

donor_sources.observation: Reasoning methods are shared textual instructions, not separately trained role adapters with transfer measurement.

features.mechanism: Target-role adapters learn selected source-role root procedures while target and source competence are evaluated separately.
features.challenge: Transferring an aggressive proposer policy into a verifier can raise apparent productivity while increasing false acceptance.

features.title: Admit trained models with their native runtime generation

donor_sources.observation: The donor executes a binary against a goal but does not jointly validate trained-model and resident-code generations.

features.mechanism: Joint admission evaluates immutable model-adapter and native-code pairs under versioned execution contracts.
features.challenge: A trained model and new runtime that each pass alone can still form an incompatible pair and must be tested together.

features.title: Demonstrate every role training serving and improving

donor_sources.observation: The donor orchestrates fixed model roles but does not train and serve a distinct RLM adapter for each role.

features.mechanism: Bounded end-to-end demonstrator trains distinct role roots, serves exact artifacts and tests their code-improvement loop independently.
features.challenge: One shared unchanged model with different role prompts, or improvement measured only on training cases, fails the demonstration.
